name: grounded
vision: A person's numbers: a small shift of weight, quiet breath, parts that settle at once.

idle: Shipped as gds/Idle (the recommendation): it reads as a person at rest from the game's camera, and the gaits' first frames stay close to it.
Tried: arms hanging closer (the wrist 135 mm from the thigh's line): the female's curled fingers were 47 mm inside the thigh; they keep 127 mm, and read 0 mm on both bodies.
crouch_idle: Kept for review (the maintainer chose B on 2026-11-12): a kneeling crouch at ease. The right foot a 0.53 m step behind on its ball, turned out 26 degrees, its knee 0.25 m off the floor and the left 0.50; the hips turned 12 degrees one way and the shoulders 11 the other; the left forearm on the left thigh, the right arm hanging outside the low knee.

Could not be done: the forearm lying on the thigh's skin on every body. Its line is held 115 mm from the thigh's, which touches the Quaternius male's thicker thigh and leaves about a centimetre of air on the form bodies'; at 105 mm it was 12 mm inside his.
crouch_walk: Kept for review (the maintainer chose B on 2026-11-11): 164 steps a minute, carried like the shipped crouch idle B, the trunk keeping half the idle's turn; the right foot tracks 18 mm wider and turns out 11 degrees for the left's 4, the left arm is carried bent 74 degrees and swings 10, the right hangs at 36 and swings 18.
Tried: the left forearm carried across the body as in the idle: the thigh that rises to the chest went 38 to 53 mm into it; both arms are carried outside their thighs.

The audit's planted rows count the frame before each landing as planted (the sole 6 mm up, inside its band of a fifth of the lift) and read 40.7 mm of wander; in the declared contacts the sole wanders 2.3 mm on the form female.
stand_to_crouch: Kept for review (the maintainer chose B on 2026-11-12), ending on the shipped crouch idle B: 16 frames; the left sole never moves, the right foot leaves at frame 3 and lands on its ball behind at frame 10; the centre of mass drops at 0.85 of gravity at most.

Could not be done: the controller's crouch_time of 0.2 s (6 frames). The centre of mass goes down 0.45 m, which a free fall takes 9 frames over; the clip is played whole, or sped up by the tree (#1158).
crouch_to_stand: Shipped as gds/Crouch_To_Stand (the maintainer's choice, 2026-11-12, after B the same day), leaving the shipped crouch idle B: 16 frames; the legs drive first, the right foot leaves its ball at frame 6 and lands flat beside the left at frame 14, the trunk unfolds after; the rise stops at 0.94 of gravity.

Tried: keeping the left forearm on the thigh by a constraint all the way up: the arm jumped 40 to 63 degrees in a frame where the constraint ran out; each arm's numbers are mixed instead and open 6 and 12 degrees round the thighs.
walk: A person's numbers at 1.7 m/s: 138 steps a minute (people take 134), a foot down 58 % of the cycle, the hips 8 degrees against the shoulders' 8, the left arm through 49 and the right through less. Shipped as gds/Walk (the maintainer's pick). Each side has its own numbers and its own timing: the right arm is held tighter with its shoulder lower and comes forward later, the right foot turns out more and its heel comes up later.

Could not be done: a knee as straight as a person's when the heel lands (ours is 23 degrees bent, a person's about 5). The step is 0.74 m on 0.83 m legs and the body is held to 37 mm of rise, so both legs cannot be straight while both feet are down.
jog: A person's numbers at 4.0 m/s: 180 steps a minute and a foot down 30 % (people: 178 and 32 %), the centre of mass 62 mm up and down on a free fall between contacts, the hips 12 degrees against the shoulders' 19. Shipped as gds/Jog. Each side has its own numbers and its own timing: the right arm is held tighter with its shoulder lower and comes forward later, the right foot turns out more and its heel comes up later.

Could not be done: the pelvis inside the old 60 to 90 mm with a low knee lift only; it goes 79 mm because the legs' own rise is counted by the centre of mass. The audit reads the planted sole on all its skin, the heel's too, which the shin drags; on the foot's own skin it is 2.4 (2.2 on the male).
sprint: 200 steps a minute at 6.5 m/s, a foot down 22 % (133 ms), landing on the ball of the foot with the heel up, the heel drawn to the seat behind, the trunk 10 degrees forward. Each side has its own numbers and its own timing: the right arm is held tighter with its shoulder lower and comes forward later, the right foot turns out more and its heel comes up later.

Could not be done: the forearm turned in across the chest as sprinters carry it (12 to 19 mm inside the chest on the Quaternius pair it was first tried on); it is turned 4 degrees out. A calf moves 70 degrees a frame faster in one frame as the foot leaves; the limit for the clip is declared at 80.

idle_to_walk: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. A body's own start: 35 and 32 frames (left, right) over 1.14 m; it gathers 7 to 10 frames, falls forward over the standing foot and is at the walk's speed as its second foot lands, on the walk's pose as that foot strikes. The right foot is free three frames sooner than the left: the idle stands on its left leg.
Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees. It is 7.6 off over a step (declared 8): the push is 1.9 to 2.0 times what a fall over the feet gives, or the start would take a quarter second more.
idle_to_jog: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 44 and 42 frames (left, right) over 3.07 m and four landings: a slow first step, two that lengthen with the hips low and the trunk pitched by the acceleration, then the jog's own two contacts.

Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (10.5, declared 12). A leg reaches 0.40 m behind the root, which holds about 3.5 m/s2; the clip peaks near 7. Tried: feet a full h a / g behind (0.8 m): half a metre out of reach.
idle_to_sprint: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 58 and 56 frames (left, right) over 6.45 m and six landings: contacts shorten from 7 frames to the sprint's 4 while the arms are at the sprint's swing from the third step.

Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (15.1, declared 20): 6.5 m/s in 1.6 s is over 4 m/s2 on average with the feet no further than 0.40 m behind. The hips come down so the legs that push can reach the floor.
walk_stop: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 33 frames over 0.48 m: the striking foot brakes, the other lands just ahead of it on its standing place, the first closes beside it, and the body settles for 10 frames.

Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (8.8, declared 10): the root is at rest 18 frames in, sooner than a body leaning back that little can stop. Tried: the striking foot kept as the idle's: it stands 37 mm narrower and 5 degrees straighter than the idle's foot, so it steps once more.
jog_stop: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 50 frames over 1.96 m and four landings after the strike: two brake steps that land up to 0.5 m ahead of the root, then the two standing places; the hips sink 35 mm as the legs take it.
Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (15.2, declared 17): braking that hard asks for near 30 degrees of lean back, and the trunk takes 40 % of it so the body does not sit down.
sprint_stop: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 67 frames over 4.82 m and six landings after the strike; the first three contacts are as short as the sprint's (4 to 5 frames), then the steps lengthen on the floor as the speed goes.
Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (15.0, declared 16). Tried: a brake step held 6 frames at 6 m/s: it covered more ground than two legs span and the pelvis went under the floor.
turn_in_place_90: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 46 and 44 frames (1.5 s): the head leads the hips by 3 frames and the chest by 1.5; the foot on the turn's side steps half the angle, the other all of it, then the first finishes: three steps, as people take (2.95 over 1.72 s for a 180, Khobkhun et al. 2021).

Could not be done: the game turns the body in 0.13 s, so the tree plays the clip by the angle turned and the head-first start is cut short in play (#1415). The thighs meet 4.6 mm on form_male in the right turn (limit 5).
jog_turn_90: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 60 frames over 5.6 m: the jog dips to 0.6 of its speed (2.4 m/s) on the plant, the outside foot, set turned 0.6 of the turn over its 8 frame contact; the root turns from 12 frames before its slowest moment to 18 after.

Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (16.8 forward, 19.2 into the bend; declared 18 and 20): a 90 degree turn at 2.4 m/s asks for near 25 degrees, which the feet landing outside the bend share with the trunk.
turn_in_place_180: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 58 and 56 frames (1.9 s, the study's 1.72): the head, then the chest, then the hips; four steps, the turn's side foot first at 0.4 of the angle, the other at 0.6, then both to their idle places turned.

Could not be done: the three steps of the study (2.95, Khobkhun et al. 2021) put the trailing thigh into the standing one; four steps keep it to 4.8 mm on form_male (limit 5). The game turns in 0.13 s, so play skips most of it (#1415).
jog_turn_180: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 69 frames, 2.3 s, ending 2.3 m from where it began: the jog brakes over two steps to 0.08 of its speed on the plant foot, turns over that foot (`_L` plants the left and turns left) and runs back out over three.

Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (16.4 forward, 8.1 to the side; declared 18 and 18): braking from 4 m/s in under a second asks for near 25 degrees; the plant stands 8 frames, not the studies' 0.5 s, or its sole wanders past 5 mm on form_male.
sprint_turn_180: Shipped as the recommendation until a letter is picked. 96 frames, 3.2 s: three braking steps from 6.5 m/s, the plant the fourth landing, set turned 0.7 of the turn, then five steps back up to the sprint; the trunk leans back up to 22 degrees.
Could not be done: the lean inside 5 degrees (22.0 forward, 9.0 to the side; declared 24 and 20), and a faster stop: steps longer than a leg spans at speed left the ankle out of reach.
